source_findings.finding: Lines59–63 route to universal durability schema/helper. Lines95–121 and137 forbid numerical gates; advisory policy predates attachment and must be superseded separately.

RecoveryPolicy default adaptive/120s/0.125/unlimitedattempts/twogenerations. Rules prescribe cross-owner optional budgets, reservation/debt/restart accounting and matched adaptive/restart observations; remove common economic mandate and relocate any independently necessary product guarantees to owning contracts.

Pure helper RecoveryPolicy/RecoveryBudget/CheckpointCandidate/CheckpointDecision/recovery_policy/checkpoint_decision implements obsolete economics; remove active module/API and sole-purpose tests/projections without compatibility fallback.
Tests explicitly bind8schema roots to RecoveryPolicy and assert changed defaults/rules alter installed identity; hard cut must repair closure, not just remove guide text.
Existing targets are report_only=true, whole validation suite statistics, not project operation numerical authority. Do not promote existing30s/5s advisory suite goals to product contracts.
Parser requires report_only=true. Retain honest noncontractual suite/resource statistics while installing separate approved common-runner production measurements.
Enforces old report-only statistics semantics. Revise blanket policy claims; preserve correctness of observational statistics; add evidence for contractual product acceptance separately.
